_readme: S395 SkyHawthorn, 2026-10-15. Read 1 (run 38749721270) printed only the OVERVIEW tab of two certificate pages whose records hold a required course with no units. This read opens every tab, to see how the REQUIREMENTS tab prints each course's units and the total. Two loads, no model call.

questions.course_units: How the REQUIREMENTS tab prints each required course's units (a column, a range, a footnote) and the total.
